era: Sixth-generation alien sandbox and modern remakes
summary: Pandemic Studios' alien-invasion sandbox series, later revived by THQ Nordic and Black Forest Games through remakes and a multiplayer spin-off.

entries.title: Destroy All Humans!
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox version for original-version play; 2020 remake tracked separately

emulation.emulator: xemu, PCSX2, or PS4 PS2 emulation route
emulation.notes: Use Xbox/backward compatibility for original play; emulate only for preservation or comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox version with compatibility/emulator scaling

primary.version: Original Xbox version / Xbox backward compatibility where owned
primary.why: The original Destroy All Humans! released on PlayStation 2, Xbox, mobile phone, and later PlayStation 4 as a PS2 emulation re-release. Because the 2020 remake is a separate franchise entry, the Xbox version is the practical primary route for the original game itself.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox version on original hardware or through Xbox compatibility where owned; use the PS4 PS2-on-PS4 release for convenience or the 2020 remake as a separate modern remake entry.

secondary.exclusive_content: Separate mobile phone version by Big Blue Bubble
secondary.what_to_play: Document or sample the mobile version separately if a legal preserved copy is available.
secondary.why: The mobile release is a distinct low-fidelity version rather than the main original-console game.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PlayStation 4 release is an emulated PS2 re-release, while the 2020 remake is a separate game entry.

entries.title: Destroy All Humans! 2
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox version for original-version play; Reprobed tracked separately

emulation.notes: Use Xbox/backward compatibility for original play; emulate only for preservation or comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox version with compatibility/emulator scaling

primary.version: Original Xbox version / Xbox backward compatibility where owned
primary.why: Destroy All Humans! 2 released on PlayStation 2 and Xbox, later receiving a PS4 PS2-emulation re-release and a separate 2022 remake. For the original game itself, Xbox is the practical primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox version on original hardware or compatibility where owned; use PS4's PS2 re-release for convenience or Reprobed as the separate remake entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PlayStation 4 release is an emulated PS2 re-release, while Reprobed is a separate remake entry.

entries.title: Destroy All Humans! Big Willy Unleashed

emulation.notes: Original Wii hardware is the reference route; Dolphin can upscale with motion-control caveats.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Dolphin upscaling with Wii control caveats

primary.why: Big Willy Unleashed released only for Wii after planned PlayStation 2 and PSP versions were canceled. Wii is the only sourced release and therefore the primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii hardware with the intended controls, or use Dolphin only if you can map the Wii controls cleanly.

entries.remaster_caveats: Planned PlayStation 2 and PSP versions were canceled; no modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.

entries.title: Destroy All Humans! Path of the Furon

emulation.emulator: Xenia or RPCS3 where legal and stable
emulation.notes: Use Xbox 360 for the main route; PS3 is a PAL-region preservation route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox 360 release, potentially improved through emulator scaling

primary.why: Path of the Furon released for Xbox 360 in North America, while the PlayStation 3 version was canceled in North America but released in Australia and Europe. Xbox 360 is the practical worldwide primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version on original hardware; use the PAL PlayStation 3 release only if preserving that regional version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.

entries.title: Destroy All Humans! (2020 remake)

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows remake at highest stable settings

primary.why: The 2020 Destroy All Humans! remake released on PlayStation 4, Windows, Xbox One, Stadia, and Nintendo Switch. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the remake. A Switch 2 port was announced for June 23, 2026, after the current archive date of June 19, 2026, so it is not counted as a shipped release here.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows remake natively at the highest stable settings; use PS4/Xbox One/Switch as console or portable alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Switch 2 was announced for June 23, 2026, which is after this archive's June 19, 2026 current date, so it is not included as a shipped release yet.

entries.title: Destroy All Humans! Clone Carnage

primary.why: Clone Carnage released as a standalone multiplayer spin-off for Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One in 2022, later becoming free-to-play on PC and Xbox One. Windows is the most flexible route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively if matchmaking or local modes are available; treat it as a multiplayer spin-off rather than a story replacement.

entries.remaster_caveats: Standalone multiplayer spin-off; not a substitute for either remake campaign.

entries.title: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Reprobed at highest stable settings

primary.why: Reprobed released first on PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S in 2022, with single-player-only PS4 and Xbox One versions in 2023. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most complete route because the prior-generation versions omit multiplayer. A Switch 2 port was announced for September 15, 2026, after the current archive date of June 19, 2026, so it is not counted as a shipped release here.
primary.how_to_play: Play Reprobed on Windows at the highest stable settings; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as strong complete console alternatives, and avoid PS4/Xbox One unless single-player-only is acceptable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Switch 2 was announced for September 15, 2026, which is after this archive's June 19, 2026 current date, so it is not included as a shipped release yet.
